// kaleidoscope of texture s0 modulated by s1, scrolled, and layered
// over s2. Showcases all four textures and demonstrates that s0..s3
// each map to a distinct sampler binding 0..3.
src(s0)
  .kaleid(6)
  .modulate(src(s1), 0.1)
  .scrollX(0, 0.05)
  .layer(src(s2))
  .blend(src(s3), 0.3)
  .out()
